title: LOLAI common contract definitions
description: Reusable definitions shared by canonical scenarios, advisor inputs and advisor outputs.

opaqueId.description: An opaque identifier. Consumers must not infer game entities or semantics from its format.

version.description: A version identifier managed by the dataset contracts.

task.description: The advisor task requested by the input.

locale.description: The locale in which the assistant message must be written.

unitInterval.description: A numeric score between zero and one, inclusive.

stringList.description: An ordered list of semantic labels.

opaqueIdList.description: An ordered list of opaque identifiers.

safeJsonValue.description: A JSON value whose object keys cannot use volatile game-data field names.

nonVolatilePropertyName.description: An object property name excluding fields whose values are volatile across game-data releases.

context.description: Freshness and completeness metadata for the observed game context.

observedAtGameSecond.description: Game time, in seconds, at which the context was observed.

freshnessSeconds.description: Age, in seconds, of the context when the request was created.

completeness.description: Estimated proportion of required context that is available.

uncertainFields.description: JSON-style field paths whose values are uncertain.

evidence.description: A single evidence record supplied to the advisor.

evidenceId.description: Opaque identifier used to cite this evidence.

type.description: The provenance class of the evidence.

freshnessSeconds.description: Age, in seconds, of this evidence.

fact.description: Structured, non-volatile facts carried by this evidence.

recentAdvice.description: A previously emitted advice record used for repetition control.

actionId.description: Opaque action identifier used by the prior advice.

category.description: Task category of the prior advice.

decision.description: Decision made for the prior advice.

ageSeconds.description: Elapsed seconds since the prior advice.

reasonCodes.description: Stable reason codes associated with the prior decision.

candidateAction.description: A candidate action that the advisor may select.

actionId.description: Opaque identifier of the candidate action.

type.description: Semantic class of the candidate action.

effects.description: Abstract effects expected from the action.

supportsFunctions.description: Abstract team or player functions supported by the action.

evidenceIds.description: Opaque identifiers of evidence supporting the action.

feasibility.description: Estimated feasibility of executing the action.

resourceRequired.description: Abstract non-negative resource amount needed for the action.

teamPlan.description: An abstract description of the team's strategic plan.

compositionTags.description: Abstract tags describing the team composition.

missingFunctions.description: Strategic functions currently missing from the plan.

damageProfile.description: Normalized distribution of abstract damage types.

physical.description: Physical component of the damage profile.

magic.description: Magic component of the damage profile.

true.description: True-damage component of the damage profile.

threat.description: An abstract hostile entity and its assessed threat characteristics.

entityId.description: Opaque identifier of the hostile entity.

evidenceIds.description: Opaque evidence identifiers supporting the assessment.
